title: Refund Policy
text:
Our Refund Policy

At Vape Shop Australia, customer satisfaction is important when you buy vapes online Australia. Our refund policy applies to all vape products purchased from our online vape store Australia, including disposable vapes, vape kits, vape pods, vape devices, e-liquids, vape liquids, and nicotine vapes.

By placing an order with Vape Shop Australia, you agree to the terms of this refund policy.

Refunds are only accepted if the vape product arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect. Customers must contact Vape Shop Australia within 48 hours of delivery to request a refund.

Proof such as clear photos or videos of the vape product, packaging, and order details must be provided before a refund can be approved. Due to hygiene and safety reasons, opened or used disposable vapes, vape kits, vape pods, e-liquids, or nicotine vapes are not eligible for refunds.

If a refund is approved, Vape Shop Australia will process the refund to the original payment method used during checkout. Refund processing times may vary depending on the payment provider.

Shipping fees are non-refundable unless the error was caused by Vape Shop Australia. Orders delayed due to courier issues, incorrect addresses, or failed delivery attempts are not eligible for refunds.

We do not offer refunds for change of mind, incorrect flavor selection, nicotine strength preference, or personal vaping experience. Vape Shop Australia ensures all vape products are sourced from reputable suppliers and checked before dispatch.

For any refund-related questions, customers are encouraged to contact Vape Shop Australia support for assistance when buying vapes online Australia.
